title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar acoustic fragment featuring a standout Frozen Logger and crisp Friend of the Devil.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised across all reviews for its crystal‑clear, perfect sound quality, typical of a high‑grade soundboard source.  Even though it’s an incomplete slice of the 1970 acoustic set, listeners highlight Bob Weir’s vocal strength and note The Frozen Logger and an acoustic Friend of the Devil as show‑stealers.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers are enthusiastic about both the musical performance and the flawless soundboard recording; the only limitation is that the source is an incomplete acoustic fragment, keeping the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently described as "fantastic", "perfect", and "great sound" with no reported glitches or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A fragmentary acoustic set from 1970; despite being incomplete it showcases strong vocal work (especially Weir) and tight acoustic playing.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocals are highlighted as the strongest version heard on this fragment.
